Item.Name: S_AGE
Item.Hint: Enter Age of order in hours

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_number boolean;
begin
 temp_number := check_numeric(:s_age);
 if temp_number = TRUE
 then
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 show_error_dist('1208');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: S_ORDER_STATUS
Item.Hint: Enter order status, leave blank for all orders.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :s_order_status is not null then
begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from vserv_order_status where
 code=:s_order_status;
 exception when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('1711');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then null;
end;
end if;
NEXT_ITEM;

Item.Name: S_FROM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter starting order date in MM-DD-YY format(leave blank for all pending orders).

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chp_sysdate DATE;
Begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate := chp_sysdate; -- Added on 08/14/2011; This field is used in order blocks where clause; IM:5833

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null then
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('orders1');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders2');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders3');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders4');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders1');
 :system.message_level := 0;
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date > chp_sysdate+1
 then
 show_error_dist('0503');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 --show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 --show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 then
 show_error_dist('1532');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 
 --Added on 05/21/2011; AV; IM: 5412
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate);
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 
 go_block('orders1');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders2');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders3');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders4');
 execute_query;
 go_block('orders1');
 :system.message_level := 0;
end;

Item.Name: S_CHP_SYSDATE
Item.Hint: Enter the beginning date as MM-DD-YY.

Block.Name: ORDERS1
Block.WhereClause:
where ((:s_order_status is null and
 order_status in
 ('AL', 'BO', 'HO', 'OP', 'OR', 'PE', 'PI', 'PK')) or
 (order_status = :s_order_status))
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and trunc(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, insert_date)) between
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date, '09-jan-95') and
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date + .9999, :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate)
 and order_class = 'ST'
 and trunc(insert_date) <
 SYSDATE - nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_age, 0) / 24
